relationships.subject: 20-HETE
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results demonstrate that 20-HETE activates TRPV1 channels on sensitized MrgprA3<sup>+</sup> neurons, and induces allokinesis in lesional CD skin.

relationships.subject: HET0016
relationships.evidence_quote: ELISA assay confirmed that 20-HETE abundance was significantly reduced in the lesional skin of HET0016 treated mice (Figure 8C).

relationships.subject: MrgprA3+ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Indeed, capsaicin induced scratching in CD model mice was abolished by DREADD silencing of MrgprA3+ neurons (Figure 2E).

relationships.subject: ERK phosphorylation
relationships.evidence_quote: Further experiments showed that MrgprA3+ neurons from MrgprA3;Braf mice, which have constitutively active BRAF in MrgprA3+ neurons, were significantly more excitable and responded more strongly to capsaicin.

key_findings: 20-HETE is elevated in lesional skin of CD mice and patients and activates TRPV1 on sensitized MrgprA3+ neurons, driving itch-biased capsaicin responses.
HET0016 reduced 20-HETE and scratching; silencing MrgprA3+ neurons blocked capsaicin-induced scratching but not wiping.
